content.title: How to watch Hawks vs. Knicks: First Round Game 2 TV channel and streaming options for April 20
content.text: The New York Knicks will play the Atlanta Hawks in Game 2 of the opening round of the NBA Playoffs. The Knicks are on top 1-0 in the series.How to watch Atlanta Hawks vs. New York Knicks Venue: Madison Square Garden Time: 8 p.m. ET TV: NBC/Peacock Streaming (out-of-market viewers): NBA League Pass Watching in person?
